description: Commission of Election - Declaring Mr. Kalantherlebbe Rafeek as a Member of the Ninthavur Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Ninthavur Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
